title: Sequential sparse Gaussian process quantile regression
abstract: arXiv:2606.31284v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Quantile regression aims to estimate the conditional quantiles of a response variable from observed data. In a Bayesian setting, Gaussian process quantile regression provides uncertainty quantification but faces significant computational challenges due to the nonconjugacy of the asymmetric Laplace likelihood and the cost of posterior inference. We develop a sparse Gaussian process framework in which the quantile function is represented through a reduced set of inducing variables and posterior inference is performed using a Laplace approximation. A decomposition of the predictive uncertainty into conditional-prior and posterior-induced variance components is then exploited to drive two complementary adaptive mechanisms: inducing-input infilling and data acquisition. These mechanisms are combined within a sequential algorithm that allocates computational effort toward the dominant source of predictive uncertainty and adaptively control

translated_title: 序贯稀疏高斯过程分位数回归
translated_abstract: 分位数回归旨在从观测数据中估计响应变量的条件分位数。在贝叶斯框架下，高斯过程分位数回归能够提供不确定性量化，但由于非对称拉普拉斯似然函数的非共轭性以及后验推断的计算代价，该方法面临显著的计算挑战。我们开发了一个稀疏高斯过程框架，其中分位数函数通过缩减的诱导变量集合来表示，并使用拉普拉斯近似进行后验推断。随后，通过将预测不确定性分解为条件先验方差分量和后验诱发方差分量，驱动了两种互补的自适应机制：诱导输入填充和数据采集。这些机制被结合到一个序贯算法中，该算法将计算资源分配给预测不确定性的主要来源，并自适应地控制
tldr: 本文提出一种序贯稀疏高斯过程分位数回归框架，通过诱导变量和拉普拉斯近似实现高效后验推断，并将预测不确定性分解为条件先验与后验诱发两个分量，以此驱动诱导输入填充和数据采集两种自适应机制，实现计算资源的动态分配。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a sequential sparse Gaussian process quantile regression framework that uses inducing variables and Laplace approximation for efficient posterior inference, and decomposes predictive uncertainty into conditional-prior and posterior-induced components to drive complementary adaptive mechanisms of inducing-input infilling and data acquisition for dynamic computational resource allocation.
